about.description: Toucan Nature is a carbon credit tokenization platform enabling fractional ownership and trading of environmental commodities. It bridges voluntary and compliance carbon markets through blockchain infrastructure.
about.registryInfo: Toucan Protocol GmbH (Berlin, Germany). Tokenization platform for voluntary carbon credits. Issues TCO2, BCT, NCT carbon-credit pools backed by retired carbon credits held in Verra registry. Launched 2021; partnered with KlimaDAO and others.

fees.revenueNotes: Toucan captures small per-token bridging fees during credit on-ramping (Verra → onchain) and pool-deposit/withdrawal fees in the BCT/NCT mechanism. No native token; protocol funded by grants and partnership distributions.
